home_question: Hello and welcome to the Home page. Keep your finger pressed on a button to hear me explain what it does.
home_desc_document: Document. Tap to read a letter or prescription.
home_desc_contacts: Contacts. Tap to call your family and friends.
home_desc_health: Health. Tap for your medications and medical appointments.
home_desc_map: Map. Tap to find help near you.
contacts_tts_intro: You are on the Contacts page. Here, you can call your loved ones or send them a photo. Just click on the call button.
contacts_desc_open_settings: Tap to allow access to contacts.
document_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Document page. Here, you can take a picture of a letter or prescription. I will be happy to read and explain it clearly to you.
document_desc_take_photo: Camera. Take a picture of your document.
document_desc_gallery: Gallery. Choose a picture already in your phone.
document_desc_new_photo: Start over. Take a new picture.
document_no_text: I do not see any text on this picture.
document_loading_label: Please wait, I am reading the document.
health_notif_med: It's time to take your medication.
health_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Health page. Here, you can save your medical appointments and medications. This way, I can kindly remind you when it's time.
notif_med_tts: Hello, it is time to take {{name}}.
help_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Help page. Here, you can ask me any question out loud by touching the screen, or call emergencies directly using the buttons at the bottom.
help_disclaimer: ⚠️ This is an automatic response. Consult a doctor for your health.
map_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Map page. Here, you can discover help and support locations near you, and I can guide you there with the GPS.
